title: It Turns Out That They Loved Warsh
summary: I feel remiss that I could not comment in real time on yesterday’s stunning rally, but I was privileged to be invited to participate in the SEC’s Roundtable on Preparations for 24-Hour Trading and thus fully committed to that event. There was indeed a stunning turnaround after the lukewarm response to Chair Warsh’s press conference, though the magnitude may have had more to do with traders’ continuing propensity to chase rallies than a sober reassessment of the fundamentals. And this morning’s very modest profit-taking amid sharply higher yields is another sign of the “ratchet effect”.
